items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: And I did a lot of gigging, with Art Hodes, Bill Tinkley.

ctx.x: And I did a lot of gigging, with Art Hodes, Bill Tinkley. And I did that until the very fine president of the Gas Light Band would hire me on Sundays. He was working at Alfred's. That's when I started with Joe Kelly.
Johnny Board's in that band now. Was he --

items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: who were some of the other musicians that went through the band? ... Art Hodes Miff, some other big name jazz musicians.

ctx.x: Yeah, you were in the new place when I came to town, which was 1960's, so -- who were some of the other musicians that went through the band? In all those years you were there?
Art Hodes Miff, some other big name jazz musicians. Jack Teagarden, Mole --
They'd come down and sit in, or --
